Why people choose Hollybrook

We use FSC-certified Siberian larch and insulate every wall, floor and roof, so your room is warm in January and cool in August. Read more about how we build on our about page.

Studios

Light, quiet spaces for painting, music or yoga.

Home offices

Made by a small team

Tom and Priya started Hollybrook in 2012. Today six of us design, build and fit every room ourselves.
